cluster_name: ICU to General Medicine A - MDR Klebsiella pneumoniae Outbreak

transmission_shifts.role_in_transmission: Exposed to Index Patient in ICU during central line and clinical care
Rotated to General Medicine A, transmitting pathogen to downstream patients
Second consecutive shift in General Medicine A

transmission_timeline:
1. Day 1 (2026-08-02 06:00): Index Patient (Rajesh Verma) is admitted to ICU Bed 1 with severe sepsis.
2. Day 2 (2026-08-03 08:00 - 20:00): Vector Nurse (Nurse Anita Sharma) works in ICU and cares for Index Patient. Sputum specimen collected shows Carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae (reported on Day 4).
3. Day 4 (2026-08-05 08:00 - 20:00): Nurse Anita Sharma rotates to General Medicine A for a 12-hour shift. She attends to Suresh Joshi (Downstream 1), Meenakshi Rao (Downstream 2), and Tarun Agarwal (Downstream 3).
4. Day 5 (2026-08-06 08:00 - 20:00): Nurse Anita Sharma works a second shift in General Medicine A with continued exposure.
5. Days 6-7 (2026-08-07 to 2026-08-08): Downstream patients develop clinical symptoms; diagnostic cultures are collected.
6. Days 8-9 (2026-08-09 to 2026-08-10): All three downstream patients test positive for the identical MDR Klebsiella pneumoniae strain.
